svg.title: Northern Ireland peat emissions compared with the whole land-use sector
svg.desc: In 2024 Northern Ireland peatlands emitted 2.31 million tonnes of CO2 equivalent, more than the 2.1 million tonnes net for all land use, because forests and grassland soils absorb some carbon. Peat is about 12.6% of NI net emissions.
svg.text: Northern Ireland, 2024: peat against all land use
Million tonnes CO₂e. NI greenhouse gas inventory, DAERA and NISRA, 9 June 2026.
Peat emits more than the whole land-use sector nets out to: forests and grassland soils absorb some, peat gives more back.
That is about 12.6% of NI’s net emissions (my arithmetic: 2.31 of 18.4).
